Definition: from G3844 and G4126; to sail near:--sail by.
BiblicalUsage: Parapleo means to sail by, to pass along the coast. It appears once, in Acts 20:16, where Paul decides to sail by Ephesus, so he will not spend time in Asia, because he is hurrying to reach Jerusalem by Pentecost.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a missionary's route is a matter of obedience, and Paul passed Ephesus by because the day set his course.
